curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What does Will’s attraction to Olivia Pitterson mean while he serves on casualty-notification duty?
curatedMovie.description: After returning from Iraq, Staff Sergeant Will Montgomery joins Captain Tony Stone in notifying families of fallen soldiers, including Olivia Pitterson.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, slow-burning, and deeply thoughtful; an emotionally demanding home-front drama suited for focused solitary viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Oren Moverman, this deliberate drama confronts the somber ritual of war bereavement on the home front with disciplined restraint and raw emotional weight.
